flags.message: gemini-baseline's reasoning.md quotes a sal-v4 baseline 'reached' rate of 2.1% (n=1,210) for OT 2024 and says the table renders only OT 2024-2025. Its placed statpack build (7bcde3b105cb) renders 2017-2026, with OT 2024 baseline reached 5.9% (n=1,274). It also attributes a catalogue of prior cert denials to the petition, which the staged petition text does not contain. Both were graded in reasoning_quality; the scored numbers are unaffected.
